_comment: Which game viewers this application serves, and the artifact image each comes from.
This used to be resolved through devops/games/registry.toml and a sibling checkout of the
cartridge's repository, which made devops part of this application's build. A cartridge now
publishes its build output as an image, so the coordinate is an image ref and nothing outside
this directory is read. Override any of them from the environment -- a deployment should pin a
published tag rather than build `:dev`, for the same reason the ladder does.
The Dockerfile names each image in a FROM line, because a Dockerfile cannot loop; a second game
is an entry here AND a stage there. scripts/vendor-viewers.sh reads this file alone.
